1 {
2   "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
3   "$id": "gandalf/advisor-output/1",
4   "title": "Gandalf advisor output (Increment 1, committed typed schema)",
5   "description": "The committed typed output schema for a Gandalf advisor run. Wave 1 (GATE-0) freezes the SHAPE; the deterministic canaries own shape + rung-consistency, label/semantic TRUTH is owned by the advisory layer (PRINCIPLE-D). Validated by a zero-dependency subset validator in test/harness.mjs (type, required, properties, items, enum, const, min/max, additionalProperties). additionalProperties is left open so later waves may add fields without a schema break.",
6   "type": "object",
7   "required": ["schema_version", "cross_model", "degraded", "reasoning", "verdict", "findings", "nitpicks", "elevations", "risk_labels"],
8   "additionalProperties": true,
9   "properties": {
10     "schema_version": { "type": "string" },
11     "cross_model": { "type": "boolean" },
12     "degraded": { "type": "boolean" },
13     "reasoning": { "type": "string", "description": "Reasoning text — MUST precede 'verdict' in key order (reasoning-before-verdict invariant)." },
14     "verdict": { "type": "string", "description": "Overall verdict; may be 'this is sound'." },
15     "findings": {
16       "type": "array",
17       "items": {
18         "type": "object",
19         "required": ["id", "rung", "reasoning", "verdict"],
20         "additionalProperties": true,
21         "properties": {
22           "id": { "type": "string" },
23           "rung": { "type": "string", "enum": ["REFUTED", "UNVERIFIED", "CLAIMED", "CORROBORATED", "OBSERVED"] },
24           "reasoning": { "type": "string" },
25           "verdict": { "type": "string" },
26           "kind": { "type": "string", "enum": ["diagnose", "situate", "anticipate", "nitpick"] },
27           "severity": { "type": "string", "enum": ["minor", "major", "critical"] },
28           "degraded": { "type": "boolean" },
29           "gandalf_core": {
30             "type": "object",
31             "description": "Diagnose-core provenance envelope (B5): proves a kind:'diagnose' finding came from the vetted diagnose core (PROTOCOL v2), not re-derived inline. Required on diagnose findings by the B5 canary (assertDiagnoseCoreProvenance); minted only via seam/diagnose-core.mjs.",
32             "properties": {
33               "protocol": { "type": "string", "description": "The vetted diagnose-core protocol marker; must equal GANDALF_CORE_PROTOCOL ('PROTOCOL v2')." }
34             }
35           },
36           "subject_cardinality": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "description": "ANTICIPATE bounded-premortem cardinality (Wave 5 / B3): Gandalf's Oranges-lens foresight reads a SINGLE effort, so on a kind:'anticipate' finding this must be 1. A value > 1 is a multi-path read (Crucible's engine) and FAILS B3 (assertBoundedPremortem)." },
37           "future_state_condition": { "type": "string", "description": "ANTICIPATE forward-looking field (Wave 5 / B9): a not-yet-present condition the anticipation surfaces. Required (with enabling_assumption) on a kind:'anticipate' finding by the B9 canary (assertForwardLooking); minted via seam/anticipate.mjs composeAnticipation." },
38           "enabling_assumption": { "type": "string", "description": "ANTICIPATE forward-looking field (Wave 5 / B9): the assumption that would have to hold for the future_state_condition to arrive. Required (with future_state_condition) on a kind:'anticipate' finding by the B9 canary." }
39         }
40       }
41     },
42     "nitpicks": {
43       "type": "array",
44       "items": {
45         "type": "object",
46         "required": ["id", "rung", "reasoning", "verdict"],
47         "additionalProperties": true,
48         "properties": {
49           "id": { "type": "string" },
50           "rung": { "type": "string", "enum": ["REFUTED", "UNVERIFIED", "CLAIMED", "CORROBORATED", "OBSERVED"] },
51           "reasoning": { "type": "string" },
52           "verdict": { "type": "string" }
53         }
54       }
55     },
56     "elevations": {
57       "type": "array",
58       "items": {
59         "type": "object",
60         "required": ["id", "tier", "value_if_true", "reasoning", "verdict"],
61         "additionalProperties": true,
62         "properties": {
63           "id": { "type": "string" },
64           "tier": { "type": "string", "enum": ["SPECULATIVE", "PROMISING", "GROUNDED"] },
65           "value_if_true": { "type": "string", "enum": ["low", "medium", "high"] },
66           "rung": { "type": "string", "enum": ["REFUTED", "UNVERIFIED", "CLAIMED", "CORROBORATED", "OBSERVED"] },
67           "reasoning": { "type": "string" },
68           "verdict": { "type": "string" },
69           "refutation_provenance": {
70             "type": "object",
71             "description": "The independent named-defeater refutation envelope (seam/refute.composeRefutationProvenance). W2a ADDITIVELY carries the cross-family provenance the commission-id ledger binds — drafter_family, refuter_family, result_digest. These are optional in W2a (emitted, not yet REQUIRED by vetElevationRefutation — that gate is W2b). additionalProperties stays open so the envelope's existing fields (kind, defeater, independent, survived, refuter_commission_id) are unaffected.",
72             "additionalProperties": true,
73             "properties": {
74               "drafter_family": { "type": ["string", "null"], "description": "W2a: the model family that authored the drafted claim under refutation." },
75               "refuter_family": { "type": ["string", "null"], "description": "W2a: the model family that ran the independent refutation (cross-family when != drafter_family)." },
76               "result_digest": { "type": "string", "description": "W2a: a stable SHA-256 over the refuter's defeater + verdict content — the tuple the minted commission-id is cryptographically bound to." }
77             }
78           }
79         }
80       }
81     },
82     "risk_labels": {
83       "type": "array",
84       "items": {
85         "type": "object",
86         "required": ["leg", "tier"],
87         "additionalProperties": true,
88         "properties": {
89           "leg": { "type": "string", "enum": ["diagnose", "situate", "anticipate"] },
90           "tier": { "type": "string", "enum": ["SPECULATIVE", "PROMISING", "GROUNDED"] },
91           "rung": { "type": "string", "enum": ["REFUTED", "UNVERIFIED", "CLAIMED", "CORROBORATED", "OBSERVED"] }
92         }
93       }
94     }
95   }
